attestations.text: Wu Wo-yao 吳沃堯 (1867–1910), was a great-grandson of Wu Jungkuang. He is better known by his tzŭ as Wu Chien-jên 趼人 (繭人), or by his pen-name Wo-fo shan-jên 我佛山人 (Buddha's Hermit), which by a clever pun may be read as Wo Fo-shan jên (I am a native of Fo-shan).
